body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review, main report §4 Disputed findings (scratchpad review/out/panel-report.md). Both verifiers confirmed the code facts; they split on whether the behaviour is a defect or an accepted documented choice. Owner instruction 2026-09-25: known issues are addressed before the next release. Settle the split (spec amendment or fix) as the finding's own 'Settles it' text says, then fix or record the accepted choice. Finding text: `cem cover`/`discriminate`/structural `mark` upgrade a map to cem/0.3 in place, which frontier and OCM refuse (wire-contract high; 1/2). Agreed: `cover.go:87`, `discriminate.go:95`, `commands.go:536` set Spec03; `frontier/types.go:22` and `tcq/canonical.go:19` admit cem/0.2 only; no 0.3 schema or packet; lrf gives a misleading "cem/0.1 only" error. Split: CEM-SM-006, TCQ-V0-052 and CF-V0-001 require each step. Settles it: owner picks one of freeze 0.3 with a packet and admit {0.2, 0.3}; keep witnesses in a sidecar; or mark the three modes Experimental in CCF-V1-003 and stop them writing over the Core sidecar path. Must be decided before rc.1 because the frozen surface is affected either way.

completion.reason: Settled: the owner accepted this finding's settlement on 2026-10-06, recorded as decision 0436 (docs/decisions/0436-panel-disputed-findings-settlement-accepted-2026-10-06.md at 07452b07fd8cfd4fc622ad90c673a323b3d6d495, PR beamfall/corvint#633; evidence digest is that file's sha256). The settlement landed on main in commit c9b5eed2, with the regression tests the decision table names (or a documentation-only scope change). No suite was rerun for this closure.
